content: For RGB-only real/sim alignment, keep known robot CAD and measured joints fixed, optimize only a bounded camera pose numerically, and reserve other configurations and recordings. Test segmentation sensitivity. Pixel improvement does not establish metric calibration; use a known-size target when CAD/mask ambiguity dominates.
embodiment: Piper single right arm, current external RGB camera and native CAD
applicability: Existing RGB/feedback exposure correspondence and visible robot; diagnostic dark-mask extractor only applies to the current bright-table scene
count_scope: Candidate metric calibrations accepted/not accepted, not task episodes
limitations: Independent recording camera placement stability not externally measured
Nominal robot FK is not independent metrology
No proof of lower total collection cost
